title: Shopping at Cabot Circus
subtitle: Phrasal verbs en pasado: try on, look for, pick up…

content.instructions: Completa con el phrasal verb entre paréntesis en past simple. Si hay un pronombre (it, them), ponlo en su sitio.

items.text: On Saturday morning Lucía ___ (get up) early because she needed a winter coat. She ___ (put on) her old jacket and ___ (go out) with Priya. It was freezing outside.
items.hint: Get → got, put → put, go → went. La partícula no cambia.

items.text: At Cabot Circus they ___ (look for) a coat for two hours. In the fitting room, Lucía ___ (try on) a red coat, a black coat and a green coat. The black one had a hood, but the sleeves were too long. She liked the green one, so she ___ (try / it / on) again.
items.hint: Con un pronombre, los phrasal verbs separables lo llevan en medio: try it on (no «try on it»).
items.explanation: Try on es separable: tried the coat on / tried on the coat, pero siempre tried it on.

items.text: The coat was only forty pounds! What a bargain! Lucía paid, and then they ___ (sit down) in a café. Lucía's phone rang, but she didn't ___ (pick / it / up) because her hands were full of bags.
items.hint: Después de didn't el verbo va en infinitivo. Sit → sat.

items.text: It was Javi. Later, Lucía ___ (call / him / back) and told him about the coat. "Green? Really?" Javi said. Then they ___ (find out) that the café was closing, so they ___ (go back) home.
items.hint: Call back es separable: called him back. Find → found.

vocabulary.definition: a small room in a shop where you try on clothes
the part of a coat that covers your head
the part of a coat or shirt that covers your arm
something that costs much less than usual
